title: source
description: One documented data source: where a file came from, which date it describes, when it was retrieved, its hash, how it was processed, the reuse terms and its known limitations (Case p.10, p.13, p.14; BUILD_BRIEF section 4).

url.description: Null only for material with no public URL (e.g. an organizer-supplied file).

relevant_date.description: The date the content describes (observation or 'as of' date), not the retrieval date.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file as retrieved.

registry.title: source_registry
registry.description: File shape of data/processed/sources.json. Each key equals the entry's source_id.
